name: ETL Myntra Partner Portal Data to Snowflake
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Myntra Partner Portal** as the data source.
2.  Select your added Snowflake data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your Myntra Partner Portal account with Name, Secret Key, and Merchant Id.
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/apollo/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
